inlineContent.text: Images convey meaning and are used in components. However, depending on your layout direction (right to left (RTL) or left to right (LTR)), changing your app’s layout can cause images to lose their meaning or take on a different one (unless they are asymmetric).

communication. Alert message includes functional icon and semantic colour, and may include as well a close button and/or action link.
Alert Message does not disappear automatically and remains visible until dismissed or resolved by the user.
Text input is a UI element that allows to enter, edit, or select single-line textual data.

Input tag is a UI element that allows to enter multiple values, each represented as a tag.
As users type and submit values (usually by pressing enter, comma, or tab), each value is transformed into a tag.
Input tag is often used for adding labels, categories, or participants.
PIN code input is a UI element that allows to capture short, fixed-length numeric codes, typically for authentication or confirmation purposes,
such as a four, six or eight-digit personal identification number (PIN).
PIN code input is presented as a series of individual input fields or boxes, each representing a single digit, to enhance readability and encourage accurate input,
while supporting smooth keyboard navigation and secured input masking if needed.
